research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SigTuple is engaged in developing a microfluidic cartridge for enriching biological fluids of low viscosity, featuring a base plate and coverslip to form a chamber for fluid processing. Additionally, they are working on a calibration slide for automated microscopes, which includes defined calibration zones divided by a cross hair to facilitate precise calibration. These efforts focus on enhancing medical diagnostic accuracy and automation.

They aim to create a data driven, machine learned, cloud based solution for detection of anomalies and trends in medical data, which improves the accuracy and efficiency of disease diagnosis.

product.description: An in-vitro diagnostic device that automates manual microscopy using robotics and AI for digitizing biological samples on glass slides for remote review.
